clue.text: Where, possibly, to get a 38D silicone implant, for example (without point)

explanation.definitionFit: A bus stop is a place where you might catch a bus such as the number 38D, so it is an example of such a place.

clue.text: VIP celebrity robber losing money to Randy

clue.text: (&18ac.) Run off your feet? Care for a low-seated bunk?

clue.text: This place calls for "hat off before sex with one"

clue.text: Minister responsible for The Blue Guide

clue.text: "Bollocks!" as proprietor, Lord Gnome claims

clue.text: "Bastard's Charter" — the last thing you'd want — no doubt will happen

clue.text: Posh's bulge
